subject: OneTrust FastPass evidence handover & minimal CAIQ patch
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@brightleaf.io>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Brightleaf Security <security@brightleaf.io>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: OneTrust onboarding - preferred handover method and CAIQ subset

Hi Rishi,

We're kicking off vendor onboarding in OneTrust for Brightleaf and want to get Redwood moved into our 'FastPass' lane (minimal friction for partners who can provide scoped evidence quickly). Can you confirm the easiest way for you to deliver the following so our security intake can move to questionnaire assignment?

- A SOC 2 Type II PDF (if available) or SOC letter stub
- A small network diagram (png/pdf) showing egress boundaries for API endpoints
- A filled CAIQ subset (we only need the compute and data protection sections for our initial review)

Options we can accept: OneTrust vendor-admin invite, upload to our secure SFTP, or a set of presigned S3 links.

If you can do presigned S3 links, please prefix file names with 'fastpass_brightleaf_' so our upload bot will pick them up.

Also, do you have any objections to us adding a single read-only OneTrust user (laura.chennotifications@brightleaf.io) to your vendor record just to attach these proofs directly?

Appreciate a quick reply — we have a 48-hour SLA on moving partners through FastPass.

Best,
Laura Chen
Security Manager, Brightleaf

Attachments: none (initial request)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@brightleaf.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding - preferred handover method and CAIQ subset

Thanks Laura — happy to get Brightleaf into FastPass. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) Preferred delivery: presigned S3 links work best for us for automated ingestion. We can also accept a OneTrust invite if you prefer us to upload directly.

2) SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II PDF (2026 reporting period). I will share a presigned link and label it per your 'fastpass_' convention.

3) Network diagram: attached as PNG in the presign bundle.

4) CAIQ subset: we maintain a minimal CAIQ patch for fast intake. Can you confirm which CAIQ question IDs you need for compute + data protection? If you share the list, Marissa (security ops) will prepare the subset answers.

Proposed coordination:
- I'll generate two presigned S3 links (SOC and network diagram) within the hour and send them to security@brightleaf.io.
- Marissa and Priyom, can you prepare a 20-min sprint tomorrow to finalize the CAIQ minimal patch and review any redlines?

No objection to a single read-only OneTrust user, but if you invite laura.chennotifications@brightleaf.io please set the role to 'uploader (limited)'.

Thanks — Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Quoted for context:
> On 2027-04-29 at 09:12 Laura Chen wrote:
> > We're kicking off vendor onboarding in OneTrust for Brightleaf and want to get Redwood moved into our 'FastPass' lane...

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@brightleaf.io>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-29T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust onboarding - preferred handover method and CAIQ subset

Thanks Rishi — presigned links are perfect. We're okay with the read-only uploader user.

I've asked our intake bot to accept files prefixed with fastpass_brightleaf_. Please send the links to security@brightleaf.io. We'll ACK as soon as the bot ingests the objects.

For the CAIQ subset, please answer these question IDs if you can: CP-1, CP-2, DP-3, DP-5, DP-7. If you prefer, Marissa, we can accept a short spreadsheet with question id + short answer (1-2 sentences).

We'll aim to complete the initial review within 24 hours of ingest.

Best,
Laura

Attachments: SOC2-Type2-Redwood-2026.pdf (will be uploaded via presign), redwood-network-diagram-2027.png (will be uploaded via presign)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-04-30T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Brightleaf FastPass handoff (presign & CAIQ sprint)

Marissa / Priyom — quick plan so we can close this within Brightleaf's 24–48 hour intake window: 

1) Presigned assets: I'm creating two presigned S3 links and will email security@brightleaf.io by 16:30 PT. Filenames will be:
   - fastpass_brightleaf_SOC2-Redwood-2026.pdf
   - fastpass_brightleaf_network-diagram-2027.png
   (I will mark expiration = 72 hours)

2) CAIQ minimal patch: Laura asked for CP-1, CP-2, DP-3, DP-5, DP-7. Marissa — can you draft 1-2 sentence answers for each in the linked Drive doc and tag Priyom for a quick technical verification? Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRedwoodCAIQDraft

3) OneTrust invite: if Brightleaf wants us in OneTrust we will accept a single uploader with limited scope. No privileged access. Otherwise presigns suffice.

4) Follow-up: once bot ACKs ingest, Laura will move us to questionnaire assignment. If they surface any evidence redlines, we'll use the 'FastPass remediation' flow and aim for a single 30-min call.

Marissa — please confirm when the answers are in the Drive doc and I'll send the presigns. Priyom — please stand by for a quick review after Marissa posts answers.

Thanks,
Rishi
